fix(daemon): read-only doctor gathers run ahead of the journal turn (candybar-launch-q7o7.fqw)

A click joins its session's queue on arrival and keeps its place through
gather and turn; only the daemon-wide turn is taken after the gather. Leading
gathers hoist out of the turn with their failures carried to their position
in the fold, a gather is a snapshot of one config and re-gathers in the turn
when that config changed, and doctor-probe leaves the turn. Idle clock pending
replaces the arrival stamp; handlers lose launcher, doctor and claudeInput.

feat(click): a button's URL says in words what clicking it does (brandon-menus-sjhy.5y2)

A dispatch link leads with a `does` param, derived from the effects the
click fires, so a hover reads `does=set+preset+to+compact` before the
percent-encoded payload. parseEffects reads only `e`, so drawn links and
older daemons are unaffected.

A click's non-session effect is its face, so a confirm reads as what it
fires rather than the disarm that precedes it. `does` is form-encoded and
loses no character; only copied text is shortened. The diagnostics viewer
passes its words, because the position it shows exists only at draw.

feat(daemon): click-rooted launches go async (candybar-launch-q7o7.gp7) (#545)

* feat(daemon): click-rooted launches go async, and a click cut by close goes no further (candybar-launch-q7o7.gp7)

* fix(daemon): clientLeft is its own fact, an aborted click launch is closing, doctor probes run together (candybar-launch-q7o7.gp7)

* fix(daemon): clickLaunch owns its bound, a terminated launch says why, stats print the journal's turn (candybar-launch-q7o7.gp7)

* test(launch): a timed-out launch says it timed out (candybar-launch-q7o7.gp7)

* fix(daemon): a launch keeps the program's own words, clickLaunch's bound cannot be passed (candybar-launch-q7o7.gp7)
